issues: 没有导出时长，工作台按 150f 默认渲染，比镜头本意（四拍后 24f 静止，共 140f）多拖 10f
浅灰/深墨双版叠在平铺灰底上，错位读作阴影，看不出是印刷没对准
标题下三张卡是通用灰条骨架，和“节拍/印刷”毫无关系
节拍刻度是四个灰点，回退字体，整张画面像线框稿
changes: 补 RISO_BEAT_PUMP_DURATION = 140（末拍归零后真静止 24f）；纸纤维与油墨颗粒都是静态纹理，泵缩放只作用画面容器，颗粒/暗角作为镜头外层不跟着缩
双版换成朱红专色 + 深墨，multiply 叠在暖色 riso 纸上；标题改为 "On the beat."（系统 SF 栈 176px/900，−0.028em），双版常驻、套准时归零重合
三张卡改为印刷鼓件卡：1.5px 墨线框 + 版号 + "Kick / Snare / Hi-hat" + 专色半调网点几何（圆/三角/方）+ 墨线波形
节拍刻度改为带拍号 1–4 的墨线圈，命中 3f 填朱红再转实心墨并常驻（8f 1.8→1 脉冲不变）；版面加四角套准十字与 "SIDE A — 75 BPM / 4 / 4" 版记；泵 1.08·exp(−t/3)、错位 4/7/11/16px 逐拍加码不变
issuesEn: No duration was exported, so the workbench rendered the 150f default, 10f longer than intended (24f still after four beats, 140f total)
Light-grey and ink plates over flat grey made the offset read as a shadow rather than misregistered print
The three cards under the title were generic grey skeleton bars with nothing to do with beats or print
The beat markers were four grey dots in a fallback font; the whole frame looked like a wireframe
changesEn: Added RISO_BEAT_PUMP_DURATION = 140 (24f truly still after the last beat settles); paper fibre and ink grain are static, and the pump scales only the picture container while grain and vignette sit outside it like a lens layer

Plates are now vermilion spot plus deep ink, multiplied onto warm riso stock; the title is now "On the beat." (system SF stack, 176px/900, −0.028em), with both plates always present and coinciding when registered
The three cards are now printed drum-part cards: 1.5px ink frame, part number, "Kick / Snare / Hi-hat", a spot-colour halftone shape (circle / triangle / square) and an ink waveform

Beat markers are now ink rings numbered 1–4 that flash vermilion for 3f on the hit, then stay solid ink (8f 1.8→1 pulse unchanged); registration crosshairs and a "SIDE A — 75 BPM / 4 / 4" folio frame the layout; the 1.08·exp(−t/3) pump and the 4/7/11/16px escalating offsets are unchanged
